name: Iron Golem
damageImmunities: and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The golem exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
